chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from al-Abbas b. Maruf from Hammad b. Isa from Hariz b. Abdullah, or another person. He said:

A group from the Juhayna tribe visited Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), and he hosted them. When they wanted to depart, he supplied them, gifted them, and gave to them. Then he said to his servants: Step aside and do not assist them. When they finished, they came to bid him farewell. They said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! You have hosted us and beautified your hospitality, and you have given and been generous in your giving, yet you commanded your servants not to assist us for our journey. So he (peace be upon him) said: We are the People of a House that does not assist its guests in their journey from our place.

key_terms.أهل بيت: Ahl al-Bayt, the People of the House of the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.الضيافة: Hospitality (diyafa), the Islamic obligation to receive and honor guests
key_terms.جهينة: Juhayna, an Arab tribe known from pre-Islamic and early Islamic history

ai.seo_question: What was the hospitality custom of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding departing guests?
ai.summary: Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (as) hosted visitors from the Juhayna tribe with exceptional generosity but instructed his servants not to help them pack for departure. When the visitors expressed surprise, he explained this as a custom of the Ahl al-Bayt: they do not assist their guests in leaving, reflecting their deep love for their guests and reluctance to see them depart.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf from Hammad b. `Isa from Hariz b. `Abdullah or another person. He said:

A group from the Juhayna [tribe] visited Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) and he hosted them. When they journeyed there, he supplied them, connected them, and gave to them. Then, he said to his servant: Step aside and do not assist them [when they leave]. When they left, they came to him to bid him farewell. So, they said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! You have hosted us and beautified your hosting, and you have provided for us and hastened your giving, yet you have commanded your servant to not assist us for our journey. So, he (as) said: We are the People of a House that does not assist its guests in their journey away from us.
